mapper.select: SELECT eq.question_id AS questionId, q.title AS title, q.difficulty AS difficulty, COALESCE(m.submitCount, 0) AS submitCount, COALESCE(m.passed, 0) AS passed, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, e.start_time, m.firstPassTime) AS passMinutes, COALESCE(m.bestScore, 0) AS score, (SELECT s.judge_status FROM tb_user_submit s WHERE s.exam_id = eq.exam_id AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.question_id = eq.question_id ORDER BY s.create_time DESC, s.submit_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastJudgeStatus, COALESCE(a.attemptUsers, 0) AS attemptUsers, COALESCE(a.passUsers, 0) AS passUsers FROM tb_exam_question eq INNER JOIN tb_exam e ON e.exam_id = eq.exam_id INNER JOIN tb_question q ON q.question_id = eq.question_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT question_id, COUNT(*) AS submitCount, MAX(pass = #{pass}) AS passed, MIN(CASE WHEN pass = #{pass} THEN create_time END) AS firstPassTime, MAX(score) AS bestScore FROM tb_user_submit WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY question_id ) m ON m.question_id = eq.question_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT question_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS attemptUsers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pass = #{pass} THEN user_id END) AS passUsers FROM tb_user_submit WHERE exam_id = #{examId} GROUP BY question_id ) a ON a.question_id = eq.question_id WHERE eq.exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY eq.question_order, eq.question_id
